description: This PHP source file generates the web interface for viewing, filtering, and downloading troubleshooting logs including system, event, and firewall logs. It includes embedded JavaScript for dynamic log filtering and AJAX-based data retrieval.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts table headers and assigns header IDs for accessibility based on provided column headers array.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to fetch logs data based on mode and timeframe, then populates the corresponding logs table.
